Arthur Fellow Senior Lecturer Henry B. Arthur Fellow Read more Trevor Fetter is a Senior Lecturer and the Henry B. Arthur Fellow at Harvard Business School, where he has been on the faculty since 2019. He teaches two MBA required courses: Financial Reporting and Control and Leadership and Corporate Accountability. He has also taught a Short Intensive Program for MBA students called The Life and Role of the CEO and is the faculty chair of a section of MBA students and co-chair of the Bridges program for second-year MBA students.
